profile.intro: I build websites and mobile apps. When I first meet someone, I’m usually happy to listen. Bring up a question I’ve been wondering about too, though, and you’ll find I have plenty to say.
profile.study: What I love most about coding is getting to try an idea that comes up in passing. Could you pick a blog post off a shelf the way you’d pick out a book when visiting a friend? In this little study, you can.
profile.invitation: There are notes about my work on the shelf and bits of everyday life in the journal. Make yourself at home. If a page brings a story of your own to mind, <letter>write me a letter</letter>. I’d love to hear it.
profile.postcard: I build websites and like tinkering with little things. This study is one of them. While you’re here, pick a book off the shelf and have a browse.
